asked.item: Does mcp.blotato.com expose an SSE endpoint (/sse)

verdict.reason: The sentences only state that the Blotato MCP server runs at https://mcp.blotato.com/mcp using Streamable HTTP (S4, S57, S72), and nothing mentions SSE, an /sse endpoint, or any fallback for SSE-only clients, so they do not answer whether one exists.
